alternates.evidence_quote: The president of CIIMAR’s Board of Directors was invited to take part of the Advisory Board of BlueBio Alliance, the Portuguese Network for Marine Bioresources and Biotech. ... CIIMAR has been a member of BlueBio Alliance and has played a role in its leadership, with Vitor Vasconcelos serving as Executive Director during the 2019-2020 term. The next step involves taking on an active role as part of the Advisory Board. This contribution allows CIIMAR to contribute with knowledge and know-how to marine biotechnology and sustainable use of bioresoureces, to the scientific work in marine sciences but also to the design of science policies regarding Marine resources.
